items.definition: Bilgi, beceri ve değerlerin öğretim yoluyla bireylere kazandırılması süreci.
exampleSentences: Access to quality education remains unequal in many parts of the world.
The government increased spending on public education this year.
She believes education is the most powerful tool for reducing poverty.

items.definition: Bir okulda veya üniversitede eğitim gören kişi.
exampleSentences: Every student in the class submitted the assignment on time.
The university welcomed thousands of new students this autumn.
Struggling students can request extra help from their tutors.

items.definition: Öğrencilere bilgi ve beceri kazandırmakla görevli kişi.
exampleSentences: The teacher spent extra time explaining the most difficult topics.
A good teacher can make even a dull subject interesting.
Teachers often work long hours preparing lessons outside the classroom.

items.definition: Çocuk ve gençlere temel eğitim veren kurum.
exampleSentences: The school introduced a new curriculum this term.
Most children in the area attend the local primary school.
The school was closed for a week because of the storm.

items.definition: Yükseköğrenim veren ve genellikle araştırma da yapan eğitim kurumu.
exampleSentences: She applied to several universities before choosing one close to home.
The university offers a wide range of postgraduate programmes.
Many universities now provide some courses entirely online.

items.definition: Bir öğretim üyesi tarafından genellikle büyük bir gruba verilen ders anlatımı.
exampleSentences: The professor's lecture covered the entire history of the movement.
Attendance at the morning lecture was surprisingly low.
Students recorded the lecture so they could review it later.

items.definition: Bir kişinin bilgi veya becerisini belirli soru ve görevler üzerinden ölçüp değerlendirmeye yarayan, sonucu genellikle puan ya da notla belirtilen etkinlik.
exampleSentences: Students spent the whole weekend preparing for the final exam.
She passed the exam with the highest score in her class.
The exam covered material from the entire semester.

items.definition: Bir üniversitede belirli bir programı tamamlayan kişiye verilen akademik unvan.
exampleSentences: She earned a degree in engineering before starting her own company.
A university degree is no longer a guarantee of employment.
He is studying part-time for a degree in economics.

items.definition: Öğrenme veya deneyim yoluyla edinilen bilgi ve anlayış birikimi.
exampleSentences: Her deep knowledge of the subject impressed the interview panel.
The course aims to give students practical knowledge they can apply immediately.
Scientific knowledge advances as new research is published.

items.definition: Belirli bir işi başarıyla yapabilme yeteneği; öğrenilerek ve pratik yapılarak geliştirilen genel yetenek.
exampleSentences: The training programme focuses on practical skills students can use at work.
Employers increasingly value communication skills as much as technical knowledge.
It takes years of practice to develop a skill like this.

items.definition: Bir okul veya program kapsamında öğretilmesi planlanan derslerin ve konuların bütünü.
exampleSentences: The school revised its curriculum to include more practical science classes.
Critics argue the curriculum places too much weight on exams.
A broad curriculum helps students discover subjects they might otherwise never try.

items.definition: Okuma ve yazma becerisine sahip olma durumu.
exampleSentences: The programme aims to improve literacy among adults who never finished school.
Digital literacy is now considered as important as basic reading and writing.
Literacy rates have risen sharply in the region over the past decade.

items.definition: Bir eğitim kurumunda verilen öğretim karşılığında ödenen ücret; ayrıca verilen öğretim hizmetinin kendisi.
exampleSentences: Rising tuition has made university unaffordable for many families.
The scholarship covers tuition but not accommodation costs.
Some universities offer free tuition to students from low-income households.

items.definition: Başarılı veya ihtiyaç sahibi öğrencilere eğitim masraflarını karşılamak üzere verilen mali destek.
exampleSentences: She received a full scholarship to study abroad.
The university offers scholarships to students with outstanding academic records.
Without the scholarship, he could never have afforded the tuition.

items.definition: Bir eğitim programını başarıyla tamamlayarak diploma alan kişi; böyle bir programı tamamlamak.
exampleSentences: She graduated from university with a degree in biology.
Most graduates struggle to find their first job in a competitive market.
He plans to graduate next spring and start working immediately.

items.definition: Bir eğitim programının tamamlandığını gösteren resmi belge.
exampleSentences: He proudly displayed his diploma on the office wall.
The college awards a diploma after two years of study.
Without a diploma, she found it difficult to apply for certain jobs.

items.definition: Bir öğrenciye özel veya küçük gruplar hâlinde ders veren kişi.
exampleSentences: Her parents hired a tutor to help her prepare for the exam.
The tutor met with each student individually once a week.
Online tutors now offer lessons in almost every subject imaginable.

items.definition: Küçük bir grupla belirli bir konunun tartışılıp derinlemesine incelendiği ders veya toplantı.
exampleSentences: The seminar encouraged students to debate the reading in small groups.
She attended a seminar on climate policy last week.
Unlike the lecture, the seminar allowed plenty of time for questions.

items.definition: Üniversite veya bilimsel araştırma ile ilgili olan; öğretim ve öğrenimle ilgili.
exampleSentences: Her academic performance improved significantly in her final year.
The journal publishes academic research from around the world.
He decided to pursue an academic career after finishing his doctorate.

items.definition: Bir üniversite veya okulun binalarının ve arazisinin bulunduğu alan.
exampleSentences: Most students live in dormitories on campus during their first year.
The university built a new library at the centre of the campus.
Campus life offers far more than just attending lectures.

items.definition: Öğretme yöntemleri ve öğretim sürecinin ilke ve uygulamalarını inceleyen alan.
exampleSentences: The training focuses on modern pedagogy rather than outdated teaching methods.
Her research examines how pedagogy has changed with the rise of technology.
Good pedagogy takes into account how differently students learn.

items.definition: Bir dersin kapsamını, konularını ve değerlendirme kriterlerini gösteren belge.
exampleSentences: The professor handed out the syllabus on the first day of class.
Students are expected to read every text listed on the syllabus.
The department updates its syllabus every few years to reflect new research.

items.definition: Başkasının fikir veya yazısını kaynak göstermeden kendisininmiş gibi sunma eylemi.
exampleSentences: The university takes plagiarism extremely seriously and can expel students for it.
Software is now used to check every essay for plagiarism.
He was accused of plagiarism after copying whole paragraphs from another paper.

items.definition: Bir öğrencinin bir dereceyi tamamlamak için sunduğu, özgün araştırmaya dayanan uzun yazılı çalışma.
exampleSentences: She spent two years researching her master's thesis.
His thesis argued that early intervention significantly improves literacy rates.
The committee asked several difficult questions during her thesis defence.

items.definition: Genellikle doktora düzeyinde hazırlanan, kapsamlı özgün araştırmaya dayanan uzun akademik çalışma.
exampleSentences: His dissertation took nearly four years to complete.
She is currently writing the final chapter of her dissertation.
The dissertation must make an original contribution to the field.

items.definition: Bir lisans derecesini tamamladıktan sonra yapılan, yüksek lisans veya doktora düzeyindeki eğitimle ilgili.
exampleSentences: She enrolled in a postgraduate programme in public health.
Postgraduate students often work as teaching assistants to fund their studies.
The university expanded its postgraduate offerings in data science.

items.definition: Henüz ilk üniversite derecesini (lisans) tamamlamamış öğrenciyle veya bu düzeydeki eğitimle ilgili.
exampleSentences: As an undergraduate, she double-majored in physics and philosophy.
The undergraduate programme lasts four years at most universities.
Undergraduate students are required to complete a certain number of credits each term.

items.definition: Bir kişinin bir okula, kursa veya programa resmi olarak kaydolması.
exampleSentences: Enrolment in the online course doubled within a single year.
The deadline for enrolment is the end of August.
Falling enrolment forced the college to cut several programmes.

items.definition: Bir derse veya etkinliğe düzenli olarak katılma durumu.
exampleSentences: The teacher takes attendance at the start of every lesson.
Poor attendance was linked to lower exam results.
Attendance at the seminar was compulsory for all first-year students.

items.definition: Bir öğretmen veya öğretim üyesi tarafından öğrenciye verilen, tamamlanması gereken görev veya ödev.
exampleSentences: She submitted the assignment two days before the deadline.
The assignment required students to analyse a real case study.
Late assignments are only accepted with a valid excuse.

items.definition: Okunan veya duyulan bir şeyin anlamını kavrama yetisi.
exampleSentences: The test measures reading comprehension rather than vocabulary alone.
Her comprehension of the lecture improved once she reviewed the notes.
Simplifying the text helped weaker readers with comprehension.

items.definition: Öğrenilen bilginin hafızada tutulup daha sonra hatırlanabilmesi.
exampleSentences: Spacing out study sessions improves long-term retention of information.
The school introduced regular quizzes to boost knowledge retention.
Poor sleep can significantly reduce memory retention.

items.definition: Bir kişiyi belirli bir hedefe ulaşmak için harekete geçiren istek veya güdü.
exampleSentences: Her motivation to succeed came from watching her parents struggle without an education.
Teachers often look for ways to increase student motivation.
A lack of motivation was the main reason he dropped out of the course.

items.definition: Bir kişinin yaptığı işe veya performansına dair verilen değerlendirme ve yorum.
exampleSentences: The tutor gave detailed feedback on every essay.
Students said the feedback helped them understand their mistakes.
Constructive feedback is more useful than simply pointing out errors.

items.definition: Belirli kurallara uyarak düzenli çalışma alışkanlığı; ayrıca üniversitede okutulan akademik bir bilgi ve araştırma alanı.
exampleSentences: Success in a doctoral programme requires enormous discipline and patience.
History is a discipline that draws on evidence from many different sources.
The teacher maintained discipline in the classroom without raising her voice.

items.definition: Belirli bir alanda başarılı olmaya yatkınlık gösteren doğal yetenek.
exampleSentences: The test is designed to measure a student's aptitude for mathematics.
She showed a natural aptitude for languages from an early age.
Employers sometimes use aptitude tests during the hiring process.

items.definition: Belirli bir meslek veya iş için gereken pratik beceri ve bilgiyi kazandırmaya yönelik.
exampleSentences: The college offers vocational training in plumbing and electrical work.
Vocational education prepares students directly for a specific trade.
More students are choosing vocational courses over traditional academic degrees.

items.definition: Daha az deneyimli bir kişiye rehberlik eden, deneyimli ve güvenilir danışman.
exampleSentences: Her mentor encouraged her to apply for the scholarship.
The programme pairs new students with an experienced mentor.
He mentored several junior researchers throughout his career.

items.definition: Belirli bir görevi yeterli düzeyde yerine getirebilme yeterliliği.
exampleSentences: The exam is designed to assess a candidate's competence in the subject.
Basic competence in mathematics is required before starting the course.
Her competence in handling difficult cases impressed the supervisors.
items.translationTR: yeterlik, yetkinlik (bir görevi gereken düzeyde yerine getirebilme)

items.definition: Bir dilde veya alanda ileri düzeyde, akıcı ve etkili beceri gösterme durumu.
exampleSentences: The job requires proficiency in at least two foreign languages.
Her proficiency in English improved rapidly after she moved abroad.
The test measures proficiency rather than basic familiarity with the language.
items.translationTR: dil/beceri düzeyinde ustalık, ileri düzey yeterlilik

items.definition: Farklı yetenek, geçmiş veya ihtiyaca sahip herkesi kapsayacak biçimde tasarlanmış.
exampleSentences: The school adopted an inclusive curriculum that accommodates students with disabilities.
Inclusive classrooms bring together students of very different abilities.
The programme aims to make higher education more inclusive.

items.definition: Öğrenme eksikliklerini gidermek amacıyla verilen ek destek eğitimine ilişkin.
exampleSentences: Struggling students were offered remedial classes in reading and mathematics.
The remedial programme helped her catch up with the rest of the class.
Some universities still require remedial coursework for underprepared students.

items.definition: İki dili akıcı biçimde konuşabilen veya iki dilde yürütülen.
exampleSentences: The school runs a bilingual programme in English and Spanish.
Growing up bilingual gave her an advantage when learning a third language.
Bilingual education has been shown to improve cognitive flexibility.

items.definition: Bir eğitim programını tamamlamadan bırakan kişi; böyle bir programı yarıda bırakma durumu.
exampleSentences: The high school dropout rate fell sharply after the new support programme began.
He was a college dropout who later became a successful entrepreneur.
Financial difficulties are one of the main causes of student dropout.
items.translationTR: okulu terk eden kişi; okul terki

items.definition: Bir kişinin belirli bir eğitim düzeyine veya yeterliliğe sahip olduğunu kanıtlayan resmi belge.
exampleSentences: Employers increasingly ask for formal credentials rather than just experience.
She earned a teaching credential after finishing her master's degree.
The certificate serves as a credential recognised across the industry.

items.definition: Bir eğitim kurumunun veya programının belirli standartları karşıladığını gösteren resmi onay süreci.
exampleSentences: The college lost its accreditation after failing to meet quality standards.
Accreditation reassures students that their degree will be widely recognised.
The programme is currently seeking accreditation from a national body.

items.definition: Aynı dönemde bir programa başlayan veya eğitimini birlikte sürdüren öğrenci grubu.
exampleSentences: This year's cohort is the largest the programme has ever admitted.
The study followed a single cohort of students over ten years.
Students in the same cohort often support one another through difficult courses.

items.definition: Öğrencinin bir beceriyi kazanana kadar geçici destek sağlayarak öğrenmesini kolaylaştırmak.
exampleSentences: The teacher scaffolded the lesson with simpler questions before tackling the main text.
Good instruction scaffolds difficult tasks so students are not overwhelmed.
The curriculum scaffolds writing skills from simple sentences to full essays.

items.definition: Öğrencilerin farklı ihtiyaç ve düzeylerine göre öğretimi uyarlamak; ayrıca bir şeyi başka bir şeyden ayırt etmek.
exampleSentences: Teachers are trained to differentiate instruction for students at different levels.
The lesson was differentiated so that advanced students received extra challenges.
It is important to differentiate between memorising facts and truly understanding them.

items.definition: Okulun normal ders programının dışında yapılan etkinliklerle ilgili.
exampleSentences: She joined several extracurricular clubs to broaden her experience beyond the classroom.
Extracurricular activities can teach skills that the classroom alone cannot.
Universities often consider extracurricular involvement alongside academic grades.

items.definition: Titiz, sıkı ve yüksek standartlara dayalı biçimde yürütülen.
exampleSentences: The programme is known for its rigorous admission requirements.
Her thesis underwent rigorous review before it was approved.
Rigorous training prepared the students for the demands of the profession.

items.definition: Anlamını kavramadan, yalnızca tekrar yoluyla ezberleme yöntemi.
exampleSentences: Rote learning still dominates some traditional classrooms.
Memorising formulas by rote does not guarantee real understanding.
The new curriculum moves away from rote memorisation towards critical thinking.

items.definition: Ders verir veya öğretici bir tavırla, açıkça öğretme amacı taşıyan.
exampleSentences: The novel has a strongly didactic tone that some readers find heavy-handed.
He preferred a didactic teaching style, explaining every step in detail.
The museum's exhibits are more didactic than entertaining.

items.definition: Geniş ve derin bilgi birikimine sahip, çok okumuş.
exampleSentences: The professor's erudite lectures often referenced obscure historical texts.
She is known among colleagues as an erudite scholar of medieval literature.
His erudite commentary impressed even the most experienced researchers.

items.definition: Zihinsel çaba, düşünme ve akıl yürütme ile ilgili.
exampleSentences: The seminar encouraged genuine intellectual debate rather than passive listening.
She has always shown a strong intellectual curiosity about the natural world.
The university prides itself on fostering an intellectual community.

items.definition: Bilimsel araştırmaya dayanan veya akademik ciddiyetle yürütülen.
exampleSentences: The journal only publishes scholarly articles that have passed peer review.
Her scholarly approach to the subject impressed the committee.
The book is a scholarly account of the region's political history.

items.definition: Bir kişiye yeni bilgi veya anlayış kazandırarak aydınlatmak.
exampleSentences: The lecture enlightened students about the true origins of the theory.
She hoped the documentary would enlighten viewers on the issue.
His explanation finally enlightened me about how the process actually works.

items.definition: Bir değer, alışkanlık veya inancı zamanla ve yavaş yavaş bir kişide yerleştirmek.
exampleSentences: Good teachers try to instil a genuine love of learning in their students.
The programme aims to instil discipline and confidence in young athletes.
Parents play a key role in instilling curiosity at an early age.

items.definition: Bir kişinin gelişimini destekleyip özenle büyütmek veya geliştirmek.
exampleSentences: Teachers try to nurture creativity rather than simply testing memorisation.
The mentorship programme was designed to nurture young researchers.
A supportive environment helps nurture a child's confidence.

items.definition: Merak duygusu güçlü, sürekli soru sorup öğrenmek isteyen.
exampleSentences: Her inquisitive nature made her ask questions long after the lecture ended.
Teachers try to keep young children inquisitive rather than passive.
He has always been inquisitive about how things work.
